meta_description:
2,244 likes, 23 comments - unicef on October 26, 2026: "Every Monday to Thursday, the Al-Hamidiyah health facility at a displacement camp in Sudan welcomes children and their parents.

Some have arrived on foot, others on trucks or donkeys – traveling from remote villages to ensure their children receive life-saving vaccines.

Behind this busy clinic is Ezzeldin, a vaccinator who has been protecting children’s health for over three decades. Now, even amid the ongoing conflict, he vaccinates more than 30 children a day.

From polio to measles, he makes sure children do not miss out on routine immunization because “diseases are like a war – they can destroy an entire generation”.

Leave a 💙 if Ezzeldin’s story inspired you!

#WorldPolioDay".
